text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Our voyage. A long, long journey in 
search of treasure somewhere in the 
world...)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(In the distant future, when everything is 
over and I look back on this journey...)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"My greatest treasure... The greatest 
treasure left in these hands is..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what it could be. A colossal 
castle, gold coins, jewels, or perhaps...
choice_data_list: Tap...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Trainer. Now, shall we face 
the ultimate dilemma?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's decide it between just you and me. 
The course this ship takes, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The ultimate dilemma. There were only 
two sea routes available to them.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First is the 'overseas challenge'. Giving 
up on an expedition with friends, and 
taking on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
alone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Performing well in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe is an important promise to the 
landlord of their base. And if she wins, 
she will obtain the "Eternal Castle."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The other option is 'maintaining the 
status quo.' Giving up on traveling abroad 
and continuing to do your best 
domestically."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's clear we're slowly running out 
of options. If we can't keep our promise 
to the landlord, the "Eternal Castle" will 
be in jeopardy too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "future" or the "now." If I had to 
choose one or the other...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what's your choice?
choice_data_list: I—
I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What is the most important thing to me? 
Thinking from that, there was only one 
answer.
choice_data_list:
I think we should take on the challenge 
overseas.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Leaving your friends behind, huh?
choice_data_list:
Ah... We'll just have to give up on that 
part.

Yeah... you just have to give up on that 
part.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no hesitation. No matter what it 
takes, I will have Tap Dance City build 
her eternal castle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's for that sake, sacrificing one 
page of my shining memories is my only 
choice.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see. But if those guys hear about 
that...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I might end up hating you. Even knowing 
that, you still want to?
choice_data_list: Even so.
Even so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, this too is for everyone's 
future. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment of glory we all aimed for 
together. I intended to settle things for 
taking it away. What I can do is...
choice_data_list: I... will step away from the group.
I'm... stepping away from the group

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer... You are...
choice_data_list:
From now on, I'll dedicate myself entirely 
to being a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as a castle is built and Tap Dance 
City and the others can live happily, I 
don't care what happens to the rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And that 'thing I didn't care what 
happened to' included myself."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
To you... even you yourself are a trump 
card. Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: A real gambler, through and through.
choice_data_list: Yeah... I want to lead you to victory.
Yeah... I want you to win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A trump card doesn't need 
self-preservation. You can't win a contest 
if you're worrying about keeping yourself 
safe.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Okay. Hearing your resolve has made up my 
mind, too."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up! Hear this! This is Captain 
Tap's final decision!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A glint flashes in Tap Dance City's eyes. 
It seems she's resolved herself.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The expedition to the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe was—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Call it off!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't... believe my ears... I thought 
I just heard that it's cancelled...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City, who had never lowered her 
banner of challenge no matter what 
happened until now, was...
choice_data_list: You're kidding, right?
You're joking, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It is no lie.
choice_data_list: Why...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I won't accept it. No matter 
what happens—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Anything but goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Think about it. Think about it. Treasure 
is certainly important. But――"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"What good is holding it in my hands if 
you guys aren't there with me?!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone steal away the time I 
spend with the folks I love. That is 
precisely――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's the whole reason we're aiming for 
that castle, dammit! And yet—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Leave them behind? Why would I do that? 
Let go of their hand? Never. I'm not 
abandoning anyone, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I won't accept it! Not a single person 
leaving my side. Of course!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you too.
choice_data_list: Tap...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City refused to allow it. Not 
even a single page of the logbook of her 
youth would be torn away and discarded.
choice_data_list: So... you're fine with that, then.
So... you're okay with that, then?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, if we have to be torn apart, I'd 
rather go down together with you."
choice_data_list: —Understood. I'll follow your lead.
—Understood, I'll follow you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, even if you don't follow, I'll just 
tie you to my waist and drag you along!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: You—belong to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City laughs. With that, the 
course for the voyage is settled, but...
choice_data_list:
Looks like we won't be able to keep our 
promise to the owner.

Looks like we won't be able to keep our 
promise to the owner.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm such a big-mouthed blowhard. 
Even though I promised to put on a show at 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I can't let things end like this! 
I've got to repay this debt somehow."
choice_data_list: The castle's far away now...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right... No matter how hard you 
try, you probably can't build an eternal 
castle here at home."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Not that I've thrown in the towel, but... 
our ship might be in some deep water.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Parting ways with Tap Dance City, I 
pondered alone. Though our course was set, 
no way out was in sight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I want to find a viable new 
course for Tap Dance City's sake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Repay my benefactor's kindness and amass 
the wealth of the entire world. Somehow, 
find a way to do both—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the sea before me, inspiration 
struck. It's true that making a name for 
yourself globally while staying in the 
country is difficult. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not that there was never a single 
Umamusume like that in the past. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There was once an Umamusume who made her 
name known across the globe, roaring, 
‘Here I stand!’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was precisely because she saw that 
Umamusume dominate that Tap Dance City is 
now here in this country..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I contacted that Umamusume 
and arranged to meet.

So you're the one who wanted to talk to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what it is, but spill it. 
Least I can do is hear you out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Katsuragi Ace. The Umamusume who once 
shocked the world with her dramatic 
front-running victory in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing right before me was the one 
Umamusume who knew the route to a 
comeback.
